title: mliport beta scientific validation result record
description: Version 2 adds explicit identity: profile_id (engine x artifact x dtype x task/head x inference mode x device class x commit x suite revision), record_id (deterministic identity of the intended computation) and run_id (one execution attempt). Records are immutable; write_result never overwrites a different record with the same case/test/engine tag.

model_sha256.description: sha256 of the exact model artifact; the literal "n/a" is allowed only for records where no model was ever loaded (blocked provisioning)

gpu_uuid_hash.description: truncated sha256 of the GPU UUID; raw UUIDs never leave the local machine

input_structure_id.description: sha256 of canonicalized (species, positions, cell, pbc)

profile_id.description: engine-<dtype>-<digest>: records with different values here are never aggregated together

record_id.description: deterministic sha256 (truncated) of the intended computation: profile, case, test, input structure, parameters, seed, suite revision

run_id.description: one execution attempt of a record_id

campaign_id.description: optional grouping of attempts that belong to one validation campaign

migrated_from.description: set when the aggregator imported a record written under an older schema version
